sloka: माल्यवान्नाम वैदेहि गिरीणामुत्तमो गिरिः ।ततो गच्छति गोकर्णं पर्वतं केसरी हरिः ।। ५.३५.८०।।।।
transliteration: mālyavānnāma vaidehi girīṇāmuttamo giriḥ ।tato gacchati gokarṇaṁ parvataṁ kesarī hariḥ ।। 5.35.80।।।।

translations.english: "Oh Vaidehi there is a famous mountain called Malyavan. From there a monkey called Kesari went to mount Gokarna.
